card.text: Explore Ducrosa in 3D with its published shape model and documented physical size scale.

introduction.text: Published lightcurve reconstruction, scaled using a thermophysical size estimate. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: Light-curve shape model
shape.detail: Published shape · grid marks missing imagery
shape.summary: Thermophysical volume-equivalent diameter 34.1 ± 0.5 km. The alternative pole solution remains unresolved; rotational phase is illustrative.

elevation.title: Shape-derived elevations
elevation.summary: Radius on the shape model minus a 17.05 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height.
